state_tier: Current simulator object pose and past 0.3s pose observations; privileged physical-state diagnostic
vision_tier: Same three RGB frames as LeWM, known PushT shape/colors, and robot proprioception history; no future object state
note: Common fixed geometry defaults. Online gains are two phenomenological response coefficients estimated from observed past only, not identified mass or friction. Predicted position/rotation scores omit explicit coverage and are calibrated against full executed E_obj including coverage.
